title_en: In Xhamllik, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment in a new residence!!!
description_en: In Xhamllik, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment in a super new residence!!! The apartment has a total area of ​​70m2 and 60m2 net.
